policy: Batch 012 reuses POSITIVE_CONSTRAINT_RULESET_V1 unchanged. No case-specific threshold or hindsight success rule is introduced.

cases.rationale: Russian hard-coal imports collapsed and supplier diversification occurred in the expected direction, but the case bundle also contains a port-restriction leg and the broader coal-market reallocation reflected multiple sanctions, energy-security and market factors; the evidence therefore supports only partial realization.

Large clean-energy manufacturing investment occurred in the expected direction and Treasury identified 45X as a major driver, but DOE's historical mechanism was explicitly described alongside domestic-content and other complementary incentives, so single-policy attribution is not clean.

European battery capacity and direct employment expanded in the expected policy-supported direction, but the later sector outcome reflects demand growth, emissions policy, multiple IPCEIs and other public/private investment rather than the first battery IPCEI alone.
